why_ai: Wet-lab synthesis, assays and GLP animal studies are hands-on, and the advance-or-kill calls are novel and high-stakes; AI speeds design but experiments still have to be run.
why_clarity: GLP studies have defined deliverables, but discovery success is ambiguous and whether a programme was right is known years later.
why_digital: Work starts from compounds, cells and animals at the bench; results leave as data and reports, and outsourcing to CROs abroad is routine.

why_ai: GLP studies need animals, vivaria and a study director accountable under 21 CFR 58, though FDA's push toward non-animal methods trims future demand.
why_clarity: ICH guidance and GLP protocols fix the package and every study's endpoints.
why_digital: In-life work on animals produces digital reports and SEND datasets for sponsors worldwide.

why_ai: Rodent and non-rodent GLP studies must still be run in vivaria under an accountable study director; small-molecule demand is unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: ICH M3(R2) defines the package, and the same study designs recur across thousands of programmes.
why_digital: Physical studies, digital deliverables, bought from CROs anywhere.

why_ai: Primate studies need specialist facilities and judgement on species relevance, but FDA's 2025 roadmap is replacing part of the work with non-animal evidence.
why_clarity: ICH S6 frames the package, but each antibody's weight-of-evidence case is argued afresh and FDA's acceptance is learned slowly.
why_digital: Animal studies and lab assays feed digital dossiers; CROs and NAMs vendors are bought globally.

why_ai: Synthesis is bench work, but retrosynthesis software and lab automation are steadily taking over route design and routine reactions.
why_clarity: A compound is made to a purity spec and checked by LCMS within days, cycle after cycle.
why_digital: Physical synthesis delivers compounds and data; buying FTE chemists offshore is the norm.

why_ai: A board-certified pathologist must make and sign the diagnosis that sets the no-adverse-effect level; AI can pre-screen but not decide.
why_clarity: Nomenclature is standardised, but severity grading varies between pathologists and peer review is the only check.
why_digital: Glass slides are increasingly scanned and read remotely, with findings delivered as data and reports.

why_ai: Dosing, handling and observing animals is hands-on vivarium work.
why_clarity: Model protocols recur, but scoring varies by technician and reproducibility is learned only in the next study.
why_digital: Animal work at the bench; results leave as data to sponsors who buy from CROs anywhere.

why_ai: The team's value is go/no-go judgement on novel programmes with years-long feedback, though its coordination work automates readily.
why_clarity: Each programme is different and whether the call was right is known years later.
why_digital: All work is managing documents, data and vendors remotely.

why_ai: Patient foundations and founders are trusted relationships making novel, high-stakes calls on tiny evidence bases; demand grows with new modalities.
why_clarity: Every rare-disease package is argued from scratch and FDA's acceptance arrives programme by programme.
why_digital: Mostly document and precedent work, with some outsourced studies, coordinated remotely.

why_ai: A rule-governed data transformation that tools and models increasingly perform end to end.
why_clarity: The SEND standard and FDA's technical rejection criteria define an exact, checkable output.
why_digital: Data in, datasets out, done by remote vendors anywhere.

why_ai: Plate QC and curve fitting are routine analyses that software already performs.
why_clarity: Weekly, near-identical analyses with known failure modes and quick checks against replicates.
why_digital: Instrument files in, numbers out, all on screen.

why_ai: Which studies FDA will require for a new modality is a novel, high-stakes judgement where sponsors pay for experienced people, often former reviewers.
why_clarity: Guidance and eCTD formats are codified, but strategy is case-specific and FDA's answer arrives weeks later.
why_digital: Dossiers, briefing packages and agency correspondence are prepared and filed digitally.

why_ai: Curating public disclosures into records is work language models increasingly do, though trusted datasets and analyst calls keep enterprise seats.
why_clarity: Programme records repeat at scale and are checked against later readouts and approvals.
why_digital: Public sources in, database and forecasts out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Federal reviewers and inspectors hold statutory authority over whether studies may begin and facilities comply.
why_clarity: Review procedures are codified, but each package's safety judgement is case-specific.
why_digital: Submissions reviewed on screen with on-site GLP inspections, and no commercial buying.

why_ai: Abstracting and indexing chemistry from literature is extraction work that models increasingly do.
why_clarity: Substances, reactions and assays are indexed to precise rules at enormous volume.
why_digital: Literature in, curated database out, entirely online.

why_ai: Clients pay for trusted judgement on novel assets in high-stakes deals, though market sizing and model-building automate.
why_clarity: Forecast methods repeat, but whether a forecast was right is known years after launch.
why_digital: Interviews, data and models delivered as digital reports, mostly remotely.

why_ai: Model-based dose decisions go to regulators and need accountable expert modellers; demand grows as FDA accepts more modelling in place of studies.
why_clarity: Model types are well defined, but each compound needs bespoke work and validation arrives with clinical data.
why_digital: Data in, models and reports out, delivered remotely worldwide.

why_ai: Study directors and pathologists running GLP studies in vivaria are accountable and hands-on.
why_clarity: GLP protocols prescribe every step and endpoint across thousands of studies.
why_digital: Physical studies, digital reports, sponsors worldwide.

why_ai: Maintaining and dosing patient-derived models is vivarium and bench work.
why_clarity: Efficacy study designs repeat with defined tumour-growth endpoints.
why_digital: Physical models in, study data out, bought by sponsors anywhere.

why_ai: Extracting deal terms from filings and releases is document work models do well.
why_clarity: Deal records follow a fixed schema checked against public sources.
why_digital: Filings in, database out, online.

why_ai: Expert-curated alerts are accepted in regulatory assessments under ICH M7, though statistical models increasingly cover the ground.
why_clarity: Predictions follow defined rules and are checked against assay results.
why_digital: Structures in, predictions out, licensed as software.

why_ai: Underwriting biotech credit and royalties is high-stakes judgement on a relationship basis, with accountable credit officers.
why_clarity: Credit terms are defined, but outcomes play out over years.
why_digital: Data rooms and models, with deals sourced through relationships.

why_ai: Site visits to vivaria by accountable assessors are physical and mandated.
why_clarity: Standards are codified and visits recur on fixed cycles, but findings are judgement calls.
why_digital: On-site inspection of animal facilities, reported in writing.

why_ai: Licensing and acquisition calls are novel, adversarial and high-stakes, with outcomes years away.
why_clarity: Each asset is different and success is known only after development.
why_digital: Data rooms and models on screen, with deals done through relationships and meetings.

why_ai: Founders and co-investors back specific partners, and each bet is novel with decade-long feedback.
why_clarity: Theses are bespoke and returns are known a decade later.
why_digital: Diligence is digital, but company creation and board work are relationship-based.

why_ai: GLP audits require accountable auditors on site, and the regulation keeps them required.
why_clarity: Audits follow 21 CFR 58 checklists with defined findings.
why_digital: On-site audits of facilities and records, reported digitally.

why_ai: Members pay for advocacy and convening, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Report outputs are loosely defined and their impact is hard to measure.
why_digital: Reports are digital, but partnering events and advocacy are in person.
